paragraphs: Yaakov ben Yitzḥak of Bet Gufnin. Yaakov ben Yitzḥak of Bet Gufnin and Yehudah ben Yaakov of Bet Guvrin testified concerning Caesarea, that it had long been treated [as part of the Land of Israel]. Tosefta, end of Ohalot, chapter 18, cited by R. Shimshon there.
